sobreMim.bio: I'm a Software Engineer and Software Development Technician, specializing in FullStack development with a strong focus on Backend. My main expertise is in PHP, Laravel and Filament, building scalable and maintainable applications. I also have experience with Java and Spring Boot for Backend development, as well as React and Vue for creating modern and responsive interfaces. In addition, I work with deployment and cloud infrastructure using CapRover, AWS, DigitalOcean and Hostinger
